travelSources.statement: Warner Falls south of Palmer at 46.43333,-87.59888, visible from M-35. Prior visitor directions say park completely off roadway past guardrail and follow signs to short trail.
State tourism listing names Warner Falls and historic roadside viewing, with off-road stopping beyond guardrail; this is tourism guidance not an MDOT traffic-control approval.
Regional listing identifies south-of-Palmer roadside waterfall visible near M-35 bridge.
Firsthand site at 46.43338,-87.59897; older field report of shoulder and informal trails. Not current stopping permission.

sixAxes.waterfallIdentity: Strong agreement: state GIS #172 and two independent waterfall/tourism coordinates on Warner Creek south of Palmer
sixAxes.landOwnership: MDOT is highway authority but highway ROW does not by itself establish legal public use of the stream bank or an informal descent; parcel/permission unverified
sixAxes.publicApproach: Travel Marquette and Michigan.org describe roadside viewing and signed short trail historically, but not an official current trailhead opening or post-2026 site inspection
sixAxes.legalParking: Two destination marketing sources describe standing completely off-road beyond guardrail, but no current MDOT site-specific turnout approval, parking restriction or as-built layout verified
sixAxes.continuousWalking: Historic short trail described, but no independent manager-verified 2026 right-of-way and continuous safe foot access to the lower bank
sixAxes.currentConditions: No confirmed November 2026 opening, shoulder safe status, guardrail position, traffic controls, or winter access at exact falls site

nextProof: Seek an MDOT official project/location/ROW or current site-specific stopping decision and landowner/trail manager confirmation of safe public foot access, independently tied to the south-of-Palmer waterfall; do not ask visitors for proof.
